steps.content: The illusion shatters and crumbles. The pink-white light fades, and the venue is returned to its original form.
The audience stirs awake and looks around in a panic, only to find a large contingent of fashionably late FAC elites sealing off the venue, completely surrounding it.

When Wynn and Eugene come to, Nightingale has already taken command of all security operations. She looks up toward the stage with unease. The emergency buffer systems are still not in place, and hundreds of meters above, the stage truss shakes violently. The platform is on the verge of collapse.
The platform you and Phanuel are on still.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wake up, Phanuel. It's time to come out of your dream... You still have the freedom to choose...

You lie flat on the shuddering platform, fingers locked desperately around Phanuel as she dangles over the edge. Her body keeps sliding down. Your arms have gone numb and swollen with blood by now, no longer able to bear her weight.
Schorl barely manages to take flight in an attempt to help, but the toll of holding back the Mania illusion is too great. Completely drained of energy, they fall the moment they lift off.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wake up. You still have the chance to start over, to become someone new... There will always be someone willing to embrace the real you...
Your strength is giving out. You have no choice but to call upon the shackles. The sharp thorns pierce through her palm, forcibly halting her fall.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Come back... You can choose to be a big star, live any kind of life you want... and experience a life that's truly your own... But you have to come back to reality first...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: My... own?
The shackles carry your voice vividly through the mental link, and at last, she opens her eyes.

She sees your face, now flushed crimson, every last ounce of your strength poured into the red thorns holding her up. The scarlet spikes spread from where your hands meet, burrowing deep, all the way to the heart. Thump, thump...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I hear it... It's so quiet.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: So this part of Phanuel... has always been completely empty.
The overloaded rigging lets out a piercing shriek. The platform gives way entirely, and Phanuel plummets.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Phanuel!
She slips past your fingertips like that doll, and the shackles shoot out in an instant.
What comes after the concert? Eliza hasn't scheduled for me.
Ah... maybe once the concert ends, so will everything.
You lean out nearly halfway over the edge to catch her. She looks up at you, at the one who refused to let her fall into the abyss. Tears begin to drop one by one onto the stage below.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I've learnt... how to express my own feelings now. Do you... still want to hear them?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We can leave that for later! Let me pull you up first!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza... Vain. Fake. The Cherubs... Empty. Shallow. Foolish.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: And Phanuel... is exactly the same as them. Am I feeling things right...? Can you... tell me I did well...?
You're completely spent now. However, backup has yet to arrive.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hold on just a little longer... I still have things to teach you...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Oh... and you. I need to describe how I feel about you, too...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Summer. Hot. Humid. The sun was so bright I could barely keep my eyes open. But you bought me ice cream. It was cool and sweet...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: The taste of freedom is... such a strange taste. But for someone like me... maybe I don't like it that much after all.

She falls. She disappears into the dim pink haze at the bottom of the stage. No sound. No camera flashes. You look down at your open palm. In the moment she slipped away, all you caught was a single feather. It's pure and white, without a blemish.
The break room at Otriana welcomes its regulars once again.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: "Even if tomorrow is a mystery~All I all I ask is for you to be with me!" Huh, I haven't heard this song in ages, but I can still remember it. Scary.
Still humming the tune, Tracy sets some baked rice and a coffee down in front of Evie.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Apologies for the wait, Lady Evie. Your humble servant, Tracy, at your service. Please enjoy your meal.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Wait, are you treating me to a meal? Didn't they fix the coffee machine and microwave already?

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Well, yes, but we haven't mended the little rift between us!
Evie accepts with a smile and, in return, hands Tracy two tickets.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: A special Mimi-meow anniversary comeback live?! How'd you get two tickets for such a rare event?! My, which lucky soul are you planning to invite, Evie? Could it be... lil ol' me?!

Tracy folds the tickets with a grin and tucks them into her pocket, then glances out the window. Down below, Phanuel's poster has been vandalized, the paint melting into puddles on the ground in the sweltering, humid air.

Phanuel and Mirrormoon Entertainment's schemes have been publicly exposed. Overnight, every piece of Phanuel's promotional material was pulled from the streets, save for this one poster, too large to take down immediately.

The office's air conditioning shields her from DisCity's relentless heat wave, one of the rare pleasures this job can offer. Then, Tracy suddenly remembers the pile of snacks from her hometown sitting at home. They'll spoil in no time under this heat. "I should bring them in for Evie soon," she thought.
She still keeps Phanuel as her phone wallpaper. A face that's cute no matter how many times you look at it. A face that once gave her strength.
[MBCC]
The TV is playing a follow-up report on the concert incident. All Hollow Syndrome patients have been treated. Eugene sits at a desk, a stack of printed papers spread out before him.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: What does "fandom" mean?
Wynn swivels her chair around, just like some teacher would.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: It refers to the fan community you belong to. Who you follow, vote for on the charts, share content for... all of that defines the "fandom" you belong to. And everything you say or do, right or wrong, will get attributed back to the host.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: What about "getting cancelled"? I feel like I hear that one all the time.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: That's what happens when an idol's image collapses. Having their private life get exposed, saying something inflammatory, fans realizing the host is nothing like the persona they imagined, and so on...

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Pop culture sure is complicated. Is it too late for me to start learning all this?
Wynn pushes up her imaginary glasses.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: It's required reading if we want to handle cases like this better in the future.
[Bar]
Joan has slipped out again in the dead of night with her guitar on her back. Within the rainy street, a familiar melody drifts out from a bar. She hesitates for all of a second before walking in.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Where's the manager? Where did she get this song? I never sold the rights to it.
Is there a friends-and-family discount then?
The person Joan expected steps out, tray in hand.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Tch... Is there anywhere in Eastside you don't work?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: That's good news for you, no? I'm practically helping you advertise your original songs everywhere. As for the royalties, just give me your account details and I'll arrange a payment plan...
Joan waves Jane off and leaves before she can even finish, moving on to the next law firm, to the next street corner.
[Small CG: Phanuel on the Street]

Elvira has analyzed the incense you obtained from Eliza. While it shares a similar scent to the Sillage Society's blend, it only contains relatively low-level mental sorcery. Eliza is clearly just the tail end of the chain.

Even so, she insisted that Phanuel knew nothing of the behind-the-scenes dealings, up to the very end. She then died under suspicious circumstances while being transferred by the Public Security Bureau. With that, Phantom Entertainment walked away from the Hollow Syndrome case without so much as a scratch.
We have no further use for her now. Just let her go. Pieces are bound to be sacrificed in the opening of a game.
Plus, we've already gotten what we wanted, haven't we?

Three days after the concert, MBCC receives an anonymous tip. The reported location is a waste processing facility on the western outskirts of Eastside. When the Bureau arrives on the scene, they find Phanuel, who's been severely injured.
[The Concert Hall After the Show]
You return to the stadium. Workers are dismantling the pink installations, making way for the next concert of some other star.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Glad we have proper investigation credentials this time. Did you find what you were looking for?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Have you found any answers regarding the true purpose behind the Hollow Syndrome outbreak?
You hand Schorl a disc that's just been restored.
Buried within the upbeat idol-style electronic track is a jarring violin melody that doesn't belong.
